name: disposition
description: The Centre Agent's own disposition surface: observe the pre-review executions it runs, answer a worker's question, record an append-only decision, and read health.
notes: Signature differences from the researcher side are intentional (docs/data-flow/work-agent.md): here answer_question takes an idempotency_key and queues a resume_of record; review_execution takes idempotency_key and offers request_revision / reject / request_human_takeover. The researcher-side surface has neither, because the replay semantics of a personal machine are a different problem (ai4-58d0).
Still no submit_owner_command and no tool that creates an execution from nothing. Centre work is triggered by candidate events, not by a command surface.
review_execution here disposes a pre-review *execution*, not a candidate. It moves the execution to needs_revision / rejected / human_takeover; it cannot formalize anything.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a Worker question; queues a resumed execution that points at the original.

tools.name: review_execution
tools.description: Dispose a finished execution: request_revision, reject or request_human_takeover.
